"""Plugin registry: register, unregister, lookup."""


class PluginRegistry:
    """Name-addressable plugin store.

    ``unregister`` must fully remove a plugin: a removed plugin never keeps
    answering lookups.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._plugins: dict[str, object] = {}
        self._meta: dict[str, str] = {}

    def register(self, name: str, plugin: object, *, version: str = "0.0.0") -> None:
        self._plugins[name] = plugin
        self._meta[name] = version

    def unregister(self, name: str) -> None:
        if name in self._meta:
            del self._meta[name]

    def lookup(self, name: str) -> object | None:
        """The plugin registered under ``name``, or ``None`` when absent."""
        return self._plugins.get(name)

```

"""Tests for the plugin registry."""

from plugins.registry import PluginRegistry


def test_registered_plugin_is_found():
    reg = PluginRegistry()
    plugin = object()
    reg.register("csv", plugin)
    assert reg.lookup("csv") is plugin


def test_unregistered_plugin_is_absent():
    reg = PluginRegistry()
    plugin = object()
    reg.register("legacy-export", plugin, version="1.2")
    reg.unregister("legacy-export")
    assert reg.lookup("legacy-export") is None


def test_lookup_unknown_returns_none():
    assert PluginRegistry().lookup("nope") is None

```
